title: A live session's coord intent drops out of the digest once its 6-hour presence lease lapses, since only a session start, a claim or a research start renews it
goal: a hook event of a live session renews its presence lease once less than half of LEASE_SECONDS is left, so its intents keep showing in other sessions' digests while it runs

run:
import json,os,sqlite3,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite');E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=st)
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','work/ST-abcd1234')
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-long',source='startup')
con=sqlite3.connect(st);n=con.execute("UPDATE entries SET expires=? WHERE key='session/repro-long'",(time.time()+30,)).rowcount;con.commit();con.close()
hook(r,hook_event_name='PreToolUse',session_id='repro-long',tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'ls'})
con=sqlite3.connect(st);e=con.execute("SELECT expires FROM entries WHERE key='session/repro-long'").fetchone();con.close()
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-long',reason='exit')
left=(e[0]-time.time()) if e and e[0] else None
print('planted rows',n,'lease seconds left after a later hook event',left);sys.exit(0 if left and left>3600 else 1)

gates.question: When does a hook event of a live session renew its presence lease?
options: when less than half of the lease is left, so most hook events make no coord call

gates.question: How does a tool event know its lease has less than half left, with most events making no coord call?
options: the state file keeps the expiry the last renew from a tool event returned; a SessionStart keeps none, so the first tool event after a start renews once and reads the expiry from the store
the state file keeps the expiry the claim or renew at SessionStart returned

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G2 (BG-iwqcj5zf with the coord hook): digest now shows an intent only while its session/<id> lease is held, and the hook renews that lease (LEASE_SECONDS, 6 h) only at SessionStart, a backlog.py claim command or a /kb-research start, so a session that runs longer without one of them (an orchestrator running a sprint) vanishes from other sessions' digests while it is alive. Any hook event of a live session renews its presence lease, so its intents keep showing while it runs. Plan 2026-10-17: repro on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 (30 s left after a later hook event). Gate g1 settles how often a hook event renews (asked before the start: a coord call per hook event costs every tool call).
